title: iz person entry
description: One person remembered. Every published entry must satisfy this schema and the evidence rules in POLICY.md.

id.description: Stable slug, lowercase ASCII. Must match the filename.

name.description: Full name as the person was commonly known.

also_known_as.description: Handles, pen names, or other names they were known by.

born.description: ISO 8601 date, or year only when that is all that is known.

died.description: ISO 8601 date, or year only when that is all that is known.

summary.description: One or two sentences: who they were and what they built.

work.description: What they made. The trace they left.

links.description: Profiles belonging to the person. Attach only after the entry is verified.

photo.description: Included only with confirmed permission. See POLICY.md.

permission.description: The licence or the record of permission granted.

sources.description: Evidence of death. At least two, at least two of them primary, and independent of one another.

kind.description: family | obituary | employer | project | news are primary. reference is supporting only and does not count toward the minimum.

archived.description: Archive copy, in case the original disappears.

languages.description: Languages the entry has been translated into, beyond English.

verified_by.description: GitHub handles of maintainers who opened every source and confirmed it.

drafted_with_ai.description: True when an AI assistant located the sources and drafted this entry. The human in verified_by is still accountable for having checked every source. Recorded openly so readers can weigh it.
